precepts.text: Raguel had one only daughter, named Sarah, and the angel said: fear not, for she is appointed unto thee from the beginning. From ever since the beginning, that was his wife. The Most High does bring people together. So do not develop bitterness and hatred toward each other over who is talking to whom: be happy for the brother; be happy for the sister. Whoever is for you is for you. That bitterness is going to change you, and it is just a matter of time before you leave the body.
precepts.point: And bringing me into captivity to the law of sin: that is what Satan is trying to do, bring you into the captivity of sin, the captivity of bitterness. O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death? I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord: so then with the mind I myself serve the law of God. Everything starts with your mind; when them evil thoughts come to your mind concerning your brother or your sister, you have to shake it off. Do not play with bitterness, hatred, or envy; when these things try creeping up in you, shake it off.

note.label: Leaven: The Root of Bitterness Part 2

precepts.why:
“But I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin”. The thoughts warring against your mind are Satan, and one of the ways he brings you into the captivity of bitterness is over who is talking to whom. Brothers stop talking to a brother because of a sister. Two sisters were cool, both liked the same brother, and now they have stopped talking to each other. That is bitterness, and that is fake.

Tobit shows how God brings people together. The angel told Tobias, “to day we shall lodge with Raguel, who is thy cousin; he also hath one only daughter, named Sara; I will speak for her, that she may be given thee for a wife. For to thee doth the right of her appertain, seeing thou only art of her kindred.” And he told him, when he came into the marriage chamber and made the smoke, “the devil shall smell it, and flee away, and never come again any more”, and they should rise up both of them and pray to God.

Then: “fear not, for she is appointed unto thee from the beginning”. From ever since the beginning, that was his wife. The Most High does bring people together. If that brother is for you, he is for you. Whoever is for you is for you.

So do not develop bitterness and hatred toward each other over who is talking to whom. Be happy for the brother; be happy for the sister. You brothers cannot stop talking to each other because of a woman, and brothers who roll like that need to repent. That bitterness is going to change you, and it is just a matter of time before you leave the body. “With the mind I myself serve the law of God”: when those evil thoughts about your brother or sister come, shake them off.

moments.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: The angel told Tobias that Raguel his cousin had one only daughter, and the right of her appertained to him, seeing he only was of her kindred.

Tobias feared the seven dead in the marriage chamber, being the only son of his father; the angel reminded him of his father's precept to marry within his kindred, and told him she was appointed unto him from the beginning.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: Raguel could not marry her to another according to the law of Moses but would be guilty of death; giving land away to whom it does not belong carried death.
